title: UPLB stray animal policy draws criticism
summary: LUCENA CITY – The University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB) has barred security guards from feeding or sheltering stray animals, particularly dogs, and from allowing them to roam or stay inside…

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – The University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB) has barred security guards from feeding or sheltering stray animals, particularly dogs, and from allowing them to roam or stay inside and around university buildings. “Internal Security Guards are assigned to ensure the security and safety of buildings, not to allow the premises under their watch to become shelters, hangout areas, or feeding grounds for stray animals,” UPLB Vice Chancellor Atty. Eric Paul Peralta said in Memorandum No. 43, Series of 2026, issued on Nov. 4. The university’s student publication, UPLB Perspective, posted the memorandum, written in Filipino, on its […]...
